about: Thermoforming materials: one record per material, every number with its source (a key of sources, or the text itself) or stand_in: true. rules apply to every material unless it gives its own. laws: hyperelastic fits the thickness model reads, each at its temperature; viscoelastic: published fits kept for a viscoelastic model (not read yet). PETG, PC and PMMA have no open fit at forming temperature (Dong 2005 for PMMA and Cheng & Chang 2012 for PC are paywalled); they run on a stand-in law until one is given.
